mission.name: InterestShield Original-Vision Production Restoration
mission.tagline: Recognizable assets, conserved cash, trustworthy comparisons. Task progress is not production readiness.
mission.northStar: Truth-first, hope-forward Velocity Banking education with correct math, explicit assumptions, private owner-scoped data, calm coaching, and no promised outcomes.

policies.notes: User approved autonomous implementation, verified pushes and recurring work. PR #256 stays draft while required production gates remain open. Do not auto-deploy, broaden access, start paid GPU jobs or mutate production data. Keep future implementation slices focused.

phases.title: Scenario and Calculation Coherence
phases.goal: Dashboard, Portfolio, Vault and Expo use consistent scenarios and budget/liability contracts.

tasks.title: Safely unify scenario ownership without overwriting saved household data
Complete equal-budget equal-liability strategy comparisons
tasks.notes: Simulator web/Expo shares liabilities/budget and now accepts affordable final payments and zero residual after scheduled payments; unsafe zero-recovery chunks and phantom routing are blocked. Calendar totals govern cadence when supplied. 289 regressions and 103 closed-form cases pass. Vault warns that its comparison is not yet like-for-like; correcting that math, Portfolio/dashboard scope, policy consistency, actual lender/calendar integration and scenario ownership remains open.

tasks.title: Implement or remove ineffective chunk-frequency controls
tasks.notes: Unused weekly/biweekly mortgage buttons removed from Simulator/Vault; monthly estimate and annual-extra approximation disclosed. Guardian frequency and minimum-only baseline claims corrected across the answer bank and independently re-reviewed. Legacy chunkFrequency/paymentFrequency values survive a real unrelated edit and route navigation at desktop/375px. No dated-frequency capability is claimed.

gates.title: Financial regressions
gates.notes: Local branch regressions pass. This does not complete cross-route coherence or lender integration.

phases.title: Backend and Release Readiness
phases.goal: Verify owner isolation, recovery and the exact release artifact before production.

tasks.title: Verify dedicated Supabase environment and owner-scoped persistence
tasks.notes: Cloud discovery found an empty name-matched candidate, not a proven app binding. No remote writes or credentials added. New standing CI uses pinned tooling and a disposable Linux Supabase Postgres17 database to replay four migrations, run the 63-assertion owner/RPC suite twice and run lint/advisors. Static/client checks pass; fresh hosted SQL execution is still pending at this preflight checkpoint. See docs/backend-isolation-contract-2026-10-20.md.

tasks.title: Verify backup, conflict recovery and cross-device behavior
Confirm custom domain and exact-SHA production release
tasks.notes: Authenticated Vercel discovery identifies interestshield.app/www on the exact app project, both verified. DNS matches, HTTPS works, www redirects 308 and all seven current public routes pass. Settings remains local-only. Candidate canonical/robots/sitemap now default to the verified domain; explicit env override preserved. Final restored deployment SHA, release env and post-promotion browser proof remain open. No DNS/production writes.

tasks.title: Resolve web and media development-toolchain audit findings without weakening checks
tasks.notes: Full media audit: 13 advisories (8 high, 5 moderate). Full patched web audit: 12 development findings (10 high, 2 moderate), while web runtime audit is clean. Use supported focused updates and fresh proof, not forced major downgrades.

tasks.title: Patch vulnerable web framework and preserve a standing runtime audit gate
tasks.notes: 60ab957 patches Next/ESLint to 16.4.2 and PostCSS to 8.5.31; runtime audit remains zero. Patch and audit enforcement passed both hosted 30b810e jobs with full hero/media/native gates. Implementation task is complete, but production promotion is explicitly a separate open release task.
